notes: The revisit screen is now the lesson's own running order: Review lesson words first, because that is how a lesson opens, then Learn, Exercise, Dialogue and Wrap-Up, each a plain centred box, and Exit back to the lesson you were looking at. The new-words and due-words steps are gone from the list, and so is the whole-lesson button: the first section runs on to the end anyway. In the wrap-up, everything below the counter now sits in the middle of the screen instead of stacking under the bar.
